lines.en: I hop across the mud, one jump at a time.
My fins brace the ground, then spring.
Between mangrove roots, I bounce through.
The mud sticks, but I keep hopping.
Each hop makes my speckles shake.
I do not walk; I only hop.
Inch by inch, I work my way forward.
By the puddle, I take a bend.
My landing is silent; the mud takes it.
My fins are like four small oars.
Up onto the fallen log, then down.
The tide pulled back; I come out.
I crouch on a root, fins folded.
A small bubble rises from the mud.
My eye turns once; nobody there.
I lick the mud off my fin.
The tide sounds muffled; I listen.

lines.zh: 一动就有人看见，我不动。
lines.en: If I move, someone sees me.
My teal spots shine even in shade.
A frog called once.
I press my belly into the mud.
The mangrove shadow covers me.
I wait for the water to go still.
My fin tips dry; I dab them wet.
Here there is only mud and roots.
Slowly, I blink one eye.

lines.zh: 我把鳍贴在根上，凉凉的。
lines.en: I press my fins to the roots; they are cool.

lines.zh: 泥水里有个影子动了动。
lines.en: A shape shifts in the muddy water.

lines.zh: 我等潮水退，那时更好藏。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to fall; hiding is easier then.
A bug has landed on my back.
You snapped a breathing root.

lines.zh: 我抬头，青色的眼睛看你。
lines.en: I look up with a teal eye.
Do not move; I look first.
Your shadow covers my mud.

lines.zh: 红树林的根下，我躲得正好。
lines.en: Under the mangrove roots, I hide well.
My fin tip twitched once.
You are too close; I am about to jump.
I know what a bucket looks like.
There is a small crab by your foot.
I shift behind the root.

lines.zh: 你的靴子糊满了沼泽泥。
lines.en: Your boots are smeared with swamp mud.
We looked at each other a while.
One of my fins is bent.
Do not step; I have five health.
I jumped crooked and fell in the mud.
It hurts; my teal spots dim.
You touched my eye.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收起来缩成一团。
lines.en: I fold my fins and curl up small.
My blood smells all through the mud.
My legs are weak; I cannot hop.
That knocked me into a root crevice.
I let out a small sound.

lines.zh: 你手里那点绿水，我看看。
lines.en: That green stuff in your hand; let me see.
That smells like the swamp.
The thing you swing looks like a bug.
I should not have jumped over.
A bit closer and my fin can reach.
Water is moving there; I want to go.
You set the bucket lower.
I stared a long time, then jumped.
Something in the mud is moving.
Just one bite, I give my word.
I hit a root and bounce back.
Who touched my fin?
Your boot bumped into me.
My schoolmate and I crash together.
I land badly and roll half a turn.
The log blocks me; I flip over it.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我眼冒青点。
lines.en: That knock filled my eyes with teal dots.
Do not step; I am by your foot.
I splatter into the mud, all of me.
Shell? I do not even have one.
Two of us hop; mud flies.
Its speckles are denser than mine.
We crouch side by side on a root.
It hops, and I hop after it.
Fin touches fin, which counts as greeting.
The mud is soft here; let us stay.
I follow it over the puddle.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛是青的，和我一样。
lines.en: Its eyes are teal, the same as mine.
We stay close and neither makes a sound.
With it here, I panic less.
I pick up a fallen leaf.
There is something in this mud.
I scoop it up with my fins.
It fell; I scoop it back up.
It is a small pebble, not food.
I push it into a root crevice.
Not edible, so I hold it for fun.
You dropped it; I will keep it.
My mouth is too small to grip.
I put it down and hop away.
A shadow is moving in the water.
Something breathes behind the roots.
I hear the mud shifting.
That frog is staring at me.
Something is coming down from above.
Something is wrong by the puddle.
My back fin stands up.
A hand reaches into the swamp.
I see the gleam of a bucket mouth.
It moved a step before I did.
I flatten down and push into the roots.
It comes around; I go around.
I watch the water, afraid to blink.
One hop, two hops; I make space.
It is slow; I am quicker.
I keep close to the fallen log.
The mud is soft; I sink in.
It is still looking this way.
I hide in the mangrove's shadow.
Stop chasing; I jump far.
I slap it with a fin.
This one did not even stir the mud.
I jump and hit its hand.
No teeth, so I headbutt.
It pulled its hand back; I won.
I slap again, very lightly.
Do not grab me; I will bite.
I fling myself forward.
After the hit, I turn and hop away.
Just enough to make it let go.

lines.zh: 我从红树根的泥里钻出来。
lines.en: I push out of the mud by the roots.
The tide just left; the mud is soft.

lines.zh: 身边还有一只，跳得比我快。
lines.en: Another one is here, hopping faster.

lines.zh: 我没有蛋，我是自己来的。
lines.en: I have no egg; I came on my own.
My first step landed in a puddle.
The swamp light is green.
I land on the fallen log and steady.
The prop roots are taller than me.
I shake the mud off my fins.
A frog is far off; I hide first.
I know this mud well.
I could hop the moment I was born.
Fire caught my fin edge; I jumped away.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，一点事没有。
lines.en: I fell from high and felt nothing.
Water closes over me; I kick wildly.
The mud burst open and threw me.
An arrow grazed my back fin.

lines.zh: 光落在我身上，斑点发烫。
lines.en: Light lands on me; my speckles burn.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，跳不高了。
lines.en: Too long without food; I cannot hop high.

lines.zh: 雷打在红树上，我抖个不停。
lines.en: Lightning struck the mangrove; I shake all over.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，泥和根都没了。
lines.en: I fall where mud and roots are gone.
